title: An-Nasr 110:1-3 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: An-Nasr, Al-Kafirun and reading joined words
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 24 (Pupil PDF worksheet: An-Nasr 110:1-3 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 24. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ (١) وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا (٢) فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا (٣)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,
And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.

keywords.def: the help and victory from Allah

questions.q: Chunk and link An-Nasr 110:1-3 with the teacher.
Listening turns: today's group says 110:1-3 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: say it softly 3 times looking, 3 times without.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Say 'astaghfirullah' three times with a grown-up today.
110:3 tells us to praise Allah and ...
questions.a: A) ask His forgiveness. 110:3: 'exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him'.

questions.q: An-Nasr 110:1: «إِذَا جَآءَ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: When something wonderful happens, what should we say to Allah?
questions.a: Alhamdulillah, SubhanAllah, and astaghfirullah: just as An-Nasr teaches.
